rca_of_the_issue: The /api/audit-logs/timeline endpoint has a Pydantic validation constraint requiring limit>=20. The frontend was sending limit=10, causing a validation error response with an array of error objects. When the frontend tried to display this error in toast.error(), React threw 'Objects are not valid as a React child' because it tried to render the error object directly.
